name: Testament of Strength expires after 3 Titanstrikes instead of lasting its full duration (#9291)
contract: Testament of Strength 300514's tooltip promises exactly 'your next 3 Titanstrikes' a cooldown reduction, the health-percentage requirement bypass and bonus damage, then expires; its own DBC record carries no ProcCharges/StackAmount, so IsUsingCharges() was never true and nothing ever consumed it, letting it buff Titanstrike for its entire duration. 300514's own two percent-modifier effects already carry the classmask that matches Titanstrike (806521 and its ranks) and route through the native Player::ApplySpellMod/RemoveSpellMods charge-consumption path once the aura is using charges; the fix reuses aura_ascension_templar_lifecycle::Apply (the same idiom already used for 806523's 2-charge buff) to call GetAura()->SetCharges(3) on apply, binding it via a new spell_script_names row, and lets the native engine auto-drop one charge per qualifying Titanstrike cast. This casts Titanstrike three times under the buff and checks the charge count drops by exactly one each time and the aura is gone after the third cast.

steps.label: Make the target eligible for Titanstrike
SETUP: Testament of Strength applies with 3 charges
Testament of Strength halves Titanstrike's 8 s cooldown
Testament of Strength halves Titanstrike's 8 s cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: after the 3rd Titanstrike, the buff is gone
